none: PAS NLM-65E0E3: Roman Nummus of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, possibly Valentinian, Reece Period 19, issue of 364-378. Obverse description: Diademed and draped bust right. Obverse inscription: (---)VAL(---) Reverse description: Possibly soldier advancing right holding labarum, presumed to be dragging captive. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.16mm, Weight: 1.76gms, die axis: possibly 5
